title: Tuning the solvation environment of polyoxometalate redox-active species to boost thermo-electrochemical cell performance
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6SE00045B, Paper
Shunsuke Ohkata, Katsuhiro Wakamatsu, Riku Hosokawa, Kazuma Iwata, Kohei Tada, Hirofumi Yoshikawa
Solvation engineering of polyoxometalate electrolytes enhances thermoelectric performance in thermo-electrochemical cells. Tailored solvent environments amplify solvation-entropy changes, boosting the Seebeck coefficient from 1.39 to 1.79 mV K−1.
